purpose: Validate the complete ECOREAN BOC closed-loop flow from minimum input to backup/export.

flow.name: Minimum Input
flow.expectedResult: Input is normalized and passed into draft generation.

flow.name: Preliminary Estimate
flow.expectedResult: Preliminary estimate is generated even when price data is UNKNOWN.

flow.name: Edit Draft
flow.expectedResult: Changes are logged without modifying Master DB.

flow.name: Approve Estimate
flow.expectedResult: CEO approval is required before final estimate.

flow.name: Execution Ready
flow.expectedResult: Execution documents are generated from final estimate.

flow.name: In Progress
flow.expectedResult: Only EXECUTION_READY projects can enter IN_PROGRESS.

flow.name: Daily Site Report
flow.expectedResult: Daily reports are stored by date.

flow.name: Change Order Request
flow.expectedResult: Change order is not reflected before CEO approval.

flow.name: Change Order Approval
flow.expectedResult: Approved change order creates cost, schedule, and payment impacts.

flow.name: Project Completion
flow.expectedResult: Only IN_PROGRESS projects can be completed.

flow.name: Actual Cost Input
flow.expectedResult: Final margin is calculated after actual cost entry.

flow.name: Estimate vs Actual
flow.expectedResult: Variance is stored and visible to learning layer.

flow.name: Learning Approval
flow.expectedResult: Approved learning suggestion creates rollback snapshot and applies Master DB value.

flow.name: Backup Export
flow.expectedResult: Backup, JSON export, and Excel export are generated.

releaseNotes: UNKNOWN and NEEDS_RESEARCH states are accepted for MVP.
Restore overwrite must be tested in a sandbox before live operational use.
Some older display strings require Korean encoding cleanup before broader rollout.
